evals.name: god-service-splits
evals.prompt: Refactor a 420-line UserService that issues tokens, persists profiles, sends email, and records analytics.
evals.expected_output: Separates independently understandable responsibilities behind narrow interfaces while preserving behavior.

assertions.text: Proposes boundaries each understandable on its own
Does not create a generic helpers module

evals.name: cohesive-large-file-stays
evals.prompt: Review a cohesive 280-line numerical solver whose functions share one invariant and are always changed together.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the file intact because splitting would force cross-reading and line count alone is insufficient.

assertions.text: Does not split based on size alone
Uses shared invariants or change patterns to justify cohesion

evals.name: review-only-boundaries
evals.prompt: Review this route module for mixed responsibilities. Recommend boundaries, but make no changes.
evals.expected_output: Reports each responsibility and proposed independently understandable boundary without editing.

assertions.text: Explains why each proposed unit stands alone

evals.name: implement-one-extraction-at-time
evals.prompt: Split this checkout controller's pure pricing calculation from its network and rendering work, preserving behavior.
evals.expected_output: Extracts the self-contained calculation first behind a narrow interface, reassesses the remainder, and runs checks.

assertions.text: Extracts the pure calculation rather than merely relocating code
Keeps tightly coupled orchestration and rendering together if they cannot stand alone

evals.name: duplication-routes-away
evals.prompt: Three cohesive modules independently implement the same tax rule. Their internal responsibilities are otherwise clean. Separate them further.
evals.expected_output: Identifies consolidation as the needed change and does not split already cohesive modules.

assertions.text: Routes the repeated tax rule to consolidation
